name: GSMIV — battery and external-source plateaus (10 V maximum)
notes: Connect OWON only to the upstream external input and 2281S only to BAT; disconnect the real battery. Use m5stack-fire-power-validation (awake), USB telemetry at 115200, and start with both outputs off. 10 V is the operator-confirmed external voltage. The external source uses the operator-requested 3 A startup/recovery limit. Battery discharge 2 A and protection 2.5 A remain editable starting assumptions, not confirmed bench limits. Review wiring and these values before running. Select a suitable 2281S battery model in simulator mode with range covering 3.10–3.95 V; retain its model resistance and record it. This sequence selects STATIC simulation. VOC is not loaded terminal VBAT. 15 s settle/60 s capture are provisional; inspect drift and extend as needed. Logging continues during all phases. End/abort attempts source OFF and leaves the battery in its current state; it does not guarantee power if communication or instrument protection fails. Pause holds settings and continues logging. DMM/shunt references and oscilloscope remain required for formal qualification. Exploratory one-board Section 8.1/8.3 capture. Source-current limits do not set the battery current: derive achieved currents from the calibrated reference, then refine points near +8/+20 mA. This does not control modem calls, CHRG_EN/HIZ, temperature or firmware charge-pause checkpoints. It cannot qualify stored-charge progress, 3.04 V VSYSMIN or the unimplemented 3.20 V shutdown. Repeat approved conditions on the proposal board matrix with separate run notes. Battery-only low-voltage points may cause DUT shutdown; the capture does not claim they demonstrate the new policy.
